findings.title: Task 8 breaks tests/valkyrnRounds.test.ts:58, which Step 10 runs and expects to PASS
findings.claim: Task 8 gives `emptyRound()` a `room: 0` member, and `stepRounds` empties an ended entry with `Object.assign(r, emptyRound())`. `tests/valkyrnRounds.test.ts:58` pins the emptied entry with an exact `toEqual({ x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, age: 0, owner: 0, active: false })`. Vitest's `toEqual` ignores only undefined properties, so the received `room: 0` makes the check fail. Task 8 does not list this file among its kind (a) edits (Files: w4PewFire, w4Autocannon, engineeringFog, pewUi, pewViews, pewRounds), yet Step 10 runs it and expects all PASS. It is also the only exact round-entry pin in `tests/`: I grepped for round literals and `toEqual({ x:` and found no other.
findings.evidence: plan L2428 (`emptyRound` gains `room: 0`); plan L2128 (kind (a) list without valkyrnRounds); plan L2722-L2723 (Step 10 runs `tests/valkyrnRounds.test.ts`, expects all PASS); .worktrees/w4/tests/valkyrnRounds.test.ts:L57-L58; .worktrees/w4/src/renderer/src/sim/tactical/gun.ts:L176 (`Object.assign(r, emptyRound())`)
findings.why: A test the plan says will pass cannot pass. It is a Valkyrn test sitting next to the fence list, so one implementer would treat it as untouchable and stop, and another would rewrite it without a citation.
findings.fix: In Task 8 Step 8, add `tests/valkyrnRounds.test.ts` as a kind (a) edit citing W-4 amendment §3.3: change L58's expectation to `{ x: 0, y: 0, vx: 0, vy: 0, age: 0, owner: 0, active: false, room: 0 }` (a free entry holds zeros, its room included). Add the file to Files and to Step 12's `git add`, and state in Global Constraints that it is not a fence.

findings.title: Task 9 writes two tests into tests/onlineDuelSession.test.ts but never stages that file
findings.claim: Task 9 Step 1 adds two cases to `tests/onlineDuelSession.test.ts`'s Hound block (the source's `turret(0)` and `turret(1)` predictions), and Step 5 runs that file. But neither Task 9's Files list nor its Step 6 `git add` names it. Under the plan's stage-by-name rule, the edit stays uncommitted until Task 12, which stages the same file for its own reasons, so Task 9's tests would land in Task 12's commit.
findings.evidence: plan L2745 (Files: only `tests/w4Online.test.ts`); plan L2791-L2825 (cases added to onlineDuelSession.test.ts); plan L2882 (Step 5 runs it); plan L2888 (`git add` without it); plan L3702 (Task 12 stages it)
findings.why: Every task is meant to end committed and clean. As written, Task 9's commit is missing its own tests and Task 12's commit misattributes them, which breaks bisecting and the per-task review.
findings.fix: Add `tests/onlineDuelSession.test.ts` to Task 9's Files (Modify) and to its Step 6 `git add`.

findings.title: Task 11 does not say where the PEW PEW tag goes in the JSX, and placed early it sits under the card's click overlay
findings.claim: The PEW PEW row's select target is a `console-card-pew` div whose Box has `pointerEvents: 'auto'` and spans x0 to right and top+6 to top+22. The new `gun-mode-pew` Button covers top+4 to top+22 on the same row. `Button` sets no z-index, so DOM order decides which one takes a click. The plan says to put the tag 'on the PEW PEW row, between its PEW PEW label and the charge pips'. Read literally, that is right after the label at L128, before the overlay at L133, which leaves almost all of the tag under the overlay. A real click would then select pew pew instead of flipping its switch. The jsdom test fires `pointerDown` on the tag element directly, so it passes either way.
findings.evidence: plan L3267 (the tag's position, nothing on DOM order); .worktrees/w4/src/renderer/src/ui/duel/WeaponsStation.tsx:L128 (the label), L133-L135 (the overlay div with its pointer-events Box); .worktrees/w4/src/renderer/src/ui/stage/Button.tsx:L56-L61 (absolute position, no z-index); plan L3175-L3184 (the test fires on the tag itself)
findings.why: Two implementers would place it differently, and one placement ships a tag that cannot be clicked in the real UI while the tests stay green.
findings.fix: State that the `gun-mode-pew` Button is rendered after the `console-card-pew` div, as the TORPEDO tag follows its Card. Add an assertion that the tag comes later in the DOM than the overlay: `q('[data-testid="console-card-pew"]')!.compareDocumentPosition(tags()[0]!) & Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING`.

findings.title: Task 5 tolerates a failing duelGates seed, but the known-red window opens duelGates only at Task 7
findings.claim: Task 5 Step 7 says a failing `duelGates` per-seed test should be recorded for Task 13 and the task should go on. The Global Constraints open `duelGates`' per-seed tests in the known-red window only 'from Task 7 … until Task 13', and every other test must pass at the end of each task.
findings.evidence: plan L1192 (Task 5 Step 7); plan L52 (the window from Task 7); plan L53 ('Every other test passes at the end of each task')
findings.why: The two rules contradict each other. An implementer cannot tell whether a red seed after Task 5 is a stop or a note.
findings.fix: Either extend the duelGates entry to 'from Task 5 (turrets move rounds)', or change Task 5 Step 7 to 'a failing per-seed test here is a defect: stop and report'.
